answer: Make each join cost a fresh kernel: a hardware-bound, non-transferable proof that one physical unit did the work, so n clones need n kernels instead of one wallet sliced thin. Weight attestations on a comet clock, so reputation decays on a fixed schedule rather than on activity, letting parked clones cool while honest tenures keep a steady tail. Then require cross-cluster quorums with a per-cut cap, plus an opal receipt minted once per verified device and burned when a correlated audit failure fires in the same minute: the operator pays for every lens, not for one.
